title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 29
text:
Location Coverage Specific Ded
• Deductibles may apply per unit of insurance, meaning the deductible is 
specific to coverage type (CV1, CV2, CV3). This is most typically seen in % 
deductibles.
• Coverage specific deductibles are entered in the _CV1DED, _CV2DED 
columns in the loc file for a given peril (EQCV1DED, EQCV2DED etc).
• Monetary values or % deductibles can be entered here (% in decimal format).
• Filter for your selected criteria (e.g. California) and apply relevant deductible 
for that peril.
• Coverage deductibles can be viewed in RiskLink in the loc table, within the 
coverage table for each location.
